_ordering_rationale: Pilier (Management Solutions) > PEO/Insurance > Interest funds > metriques operationnelles (worksite, retention).

kpis.signal: Coeur metier Paychex : HCM + paie SMB, ~75% du CA service, croissance regulière
kpis.description_fr: CA Management Solutions = paie + HCM tech (Paychex Flex, SurePayroll) + HR advisory + ancillary services. ~75% du CA service FY25. Acquisition Paycor contribue depuis FY25.
kpis.description_en: Management Solutions revenue: payroll + HCM tech (Paychex Flex, SurePayroll) + HR advisory + ancillary. ~75% of FY25 service revenue. Paycor acquisition contributes since FY25.

kpis.signal: Segment de croissance avec marges attractives, levier wages PEO + primes assurance
kpis.description_fr: PEO (professional employer organization) = outsourcing complet RH + assurance. Croissance par worksite employees + primes sante. ~25% du CA service FY25.
kpis.description_en: PEO (professional employer organization): full HR + insurance outsourcing. Growth driven by worksite employees + health premiums. ~25% of FY25 service revenue.

kpis.short: Interest on Funds Held for Clients
kpis.name_en: Interest on Funds Held for Clients
kpis.signal: Float sur fonds paie clients, levier taux Fed, beneficiaire de la hausse rates 2022-2024
kpis.description_fr: Paychex detient temporairement les fonds de paie des clients avant versement. Revenu d'interet sur ce float. Tres sensible aux taux courts US.
kpis.description_en: Paychex temporarily holds client payroll funds before remittance. Interest income on this float. Highly sensitive to US short rates.

kpis.name_en: HR Solutions and PEO Worksite Employees
kpis.signal: Metrique d'echelle PEO/ASO, croissance soutenue, indicateur penetration HR outsourcing
kpis.description_fr: Nombre d'employes sur sites clients couverts par les solutions ASO + PEO de Paychex. KPI d'echelle pour le segment HR outsourcing.
kpis.description_en: Worksite employees at clients covered by Paychex ASO + PEO solutions. Scale KPI for HR outsourcing segment.

kpis.signal: Indicateur de stickiness produit, recule du record FY21 (85%) vers la fourchette 82-83%
kpis.description_fr: Pourcentage du parc client (base de debut d'exercice) conserve sur l'annee fiscale. Reference : 82-83% sur FY23-FY25, contre 84-85% FY21-FY22.
kpis.description_en: Percentage of starting client base retained over the fiscal year. Range 82-83% in FY23-FY25, versus 84-85% in FY21-FY22.

kpis.name_en: Asset Value of Retirement Solutions Participants Funds
kpis.signal: Encours retraite gerees pour participants clients, levier marche + nouveau plans
kpis.description_fr: Valeur des actifs des participants aux plans retraite servis par Paychex (recordkeeping). 55,7 Mds $ a fin FY25 vs 51,8 a fin FY24.
kpis.description_en: Asset value of retirement plan participants served by Paychex (recordkeeping). $55.7B end FY25 vs $51.8B end FY24.
